query: UPDATE jobs SET status = $1::text, started_at = CASE WHEN $1::text = 'running' THEN COALESCE(started_at, now()) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN $1::text IN ('success', 'failed', 'canceled') THEN now() ELSE finished_at END WHERE id = $2 AND status NOT IN ('success', 'failed', 'canceled')
